versions.content: For Time Domains 0 to 15 StbM_GetCurrentTime() and StbM_GetCurrentTime Extended () shall return for the requested Time Domain the time of the Time Base , the related Status and the User Data. The current time of the Time Base shall be derived from the assoc iated Virtual Local Time , w h i c h is derived from either the referenced OS counter, a GPT or a referenced Ethernet controller (refer to StbMLocalTimeHardware ) .
